timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1500–1530 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently weak, with the KRW/USD rate holding stubbornly in the 1500s range due to a strong dollar driven by Federal Reserve policy, oil prices, and sustained dollar demand. Multiple sources indicate this elevated level is persisting, meaning you need more won to get your $2,000 than you would in a stronger-won environment.

TIP: Consider dollar-cost averaging your monthly $2,000 conversion across multiple days or splitting buys, since the rate appears stuck at unfavorable levels and waiting for won strength may offer better value over time.
